meta.name: cloud-sync
meta.description: Set up or check claude-mem cloud sync with cmem.ai Pro. Use when the user says "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories", "cmem pro", "cloud backup", "sync status", or wants their memory database backed up or synced to their cmem.ai account.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将记忆数据备份同步到云端账户
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望将 Claude 记忆安全同步到云端
copy.tagline_en: Back up and sync memory data to your cloud account
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to securely sync your Claude memories to the cloud

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你配置或检查 claude-mem 到 cmem.ai Pro 的云同步：查询同步状态、把连接值写进本机设置、重启 worker 并验证，最后报告设备 ID、待同步数量和错误。
howto.when: 当你提到“set up cloud sync”“sync my memories”“sync status”等，或想把记忆数据库备份、同步到 cmem.ai 账号时触发。

say.text: 检查一下我的云同步状态
say.note: 会报告设备 ID、待同步数和 Hub 连通性

say.text: 帮我配置 cloud sync，用我的 cmem.ai 账号
换一个新的 SyncHub 地址重新配置同步
say.note: 会先确认是否替换现有连接

howto.what_en: Claude can set up or check claude-mem cloud sync with cmem.ai Pro: read sync status, write the connection values from cmem.ai → Connect, restart the worker, and report device id, pending counts, Hub reachability and errors.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories", "sync status", or want your memory database backed up or synced to your cmem.ai account.

say_en.note: Reports device id, pending counts and Hub reachability

say_en.text: Set up cloud sync with my cmem.ai account
say_en.note: Asks for the token, user id and SyncHub URL

say_en.text: Reconfigure sync with a new SyncHub URL
say_en.note: Confirms before replacing the existing connection
